text:
leah-finance: Heads-up — Aurora Systems opened a billing dispute for May. They claim our usage metering bug double-counted some CI traffic. Sales asks for a one-time reconciliation credit and a short-term concession to keep renewal. Ask: $52,300 one-time credit + a 6-month tiered usage discount (months 1-2: 25%, months 3-6: 15%). Need quick deal-desk + legal sign-off.

omar-sales: Sales supports. Aurora's renewal is strategic and they threatened to move to competitor if not addressed. We verbally promised a temporary pricing pilot during POC.

casey-salesops: Reconciled numbers: billed tokens 2,150,000 vs expected 1,200,000 after filtering test infra. Adjusted overage ~ $59,000. Sales allowance ~ $10k wasn't applied. Proposed shared credit $52,300. Sheet: https://sheets.internal/redwood/aurora-may-recon (view).

billing-bot: Invoice snapshot: ```
Invoice: INV-2026-05-20
Billed amount: $112,400
Lines: Base COMM-1.2M: $60,000; Overage: $52,400
```

leah-finance: Notes: (1) metering bug tracked to SDK v1.3 test flagging; ops has mitigated. (2) Credit reduces revenue for period; tax impact minimal but AR must confirm. (3) Request legal clause to avoid precedent.

henry-cfo: I can approve one-off credits up to $60k with legal sign-off. Confirm AR processes and we log the concession in DEAL_DESK ledger.

frida-legal: I'll draft a short amendment with explicit non-precedent language and a clause that Aurora acknowledges the credit resolves any billing disputes through the invoice date. Draft will require customer signature. Recommended language included.

marta-ar: AR can post credit once amendment is signed and DocuSign received. GL: Customer Credits (4102). JE template suggested: DR Customer Credits (4102) $52,300 / CR Revenue (4001) $52,300; memo: Aurora May recon credit; attach amendment. Also confirm if we allow invoice re-issue or only credit memo.

omar-sales: Customer prefers a net invoice adjustment but will accept a credit memo. They will sign the amendment quickly.

casey-salesops: I'll create concession code DEALDESK-AUR-189012 and update CRM. Also recommending we flag SDK v1.3 customers for review to avoid repeat.

henry-cfo: Approved for the $52,300 credit and the 6-month tiered discount as an exception. Legal amendment required with non-precedent clause. AR to hold posting until signed.

frida-legal: Amendment uploaded: https://legal.internal/redwood/amendments/aurora-recon-189012_v1.pdf. Included: "This one-time reconciliation credit is issued solely to resolve the referenced invoice dispute and shall not constitute a change to Redwood's pricing or create precedent for other accounts." DocuSign envelope DSGN-778899 created.

billing-bot: DocuSign status: sent. Invoice INV-2026-05-20 flagged PENDING-CREDIT+DISCOUNT.

marta-ar: Once signed I'll post Credit Memo CM-2026-05-AUR and attach amendment PDF. Will coordinate tax treatment with tax team before posting.

leah-finance: Thanks team. Omar please own customer comms; Casey update SDK tracking ticket. Closing thread when credit posted and discount scheduled in billing config. :white_check_mark:
